name: Teikyuu Yuugi - WonderYellow
source:
Select your protagonist and experience wonderful adventure in the relations between different couples. Search for the mysterious witch Yukimura in a Western-style building isolated from the present world. What does it have to do with the dream seen every night? 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
选择你的主角，体验不同情侣关系中的奇妙冒险。在与现实世界隔绝的西式建筑中寻找神秘的魔女幸村。这和每天晚上做的梦有什么关系呢？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
